summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company, reporting the successful acquisition of three transmission lots (08, 09, and 10) in ANEEL's Transmission Auction No. 01/2026. The filing discloses the Permitted Annual Revenue (RAP) purchase amounts (BRL 10.84M, 16.21M, 23.75M) and discounts (59.04%, 57.24%, 51.84%) versus ANEEL's maximum RAP. No special-situation transaction such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign is involved; instead, the filing describes a standard regulatory auction win that reinforces the company's market position. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics beyond auction results are provided. This is an ordinary business update, not a special situation.
